newsitem.title: DENMARK: Copenhagen Airport 1996 traffic up 7.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen Airport 1996 traffic up 7.3 pct.

text.p: Passenger volume at Copenhagen International Airport rose 7.3 percent to 16.1 million in whole year 1996, airport statistics issued on Monday showed.
In 1995 passenger volume was 15 million. In its long-term forecasts, the airport estimates annual passenger volume growth at 4.5 percent.
Copenhagen International Airport is Europe's eleventh biggest as regards passenger volume. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen nwesroom +45-33969652
